title: Substrate Inheritance Prospective Contract v0.1

evidence_labels.SUBSTRATE_INFLUENCE: Parent intervention changes child behavior but stable predictive parent-to-child correspondence is not established.
evidence_labels.CONDITIONAL_INHERITANCE: A specified carrier-resolved feature is prospectively transmitted under stated conditions through a frozen mapping rule.
evidence_labels.SUBSTRATE_INHERITANCE: Carrier-resolved parent architecture prospectively predicts child architecture, survives intervention and specificity/null tests, and generic or scrambled controls do not perform equally well.

atlas_relationship.ARC_Atlas: independent stability or dissipation coordinates where licensed
atlas_relationship.Barrier_Height_Rate_Atlas: independent barrier, prefactor, rate, and provenance coordinates
atlas_relationship.inheritance_program: parent-to-child carrier, transformation, intervention, and specificity evidence
atlas_relationship.rule: Atlas membership alone does not establish inheritance

historical_status_rule: Older claims that conflict with this contract are OUTDATED and retained only as research history.
failure_policy: Influence-only, nonidentifiable, refusal, null, or failed inheritance outcomes are valid and retained.
